evidence_items.locator: A Focus on Responsibility, Red-Teaming Exercises
evidence_items.explanation: The release announcement reports completed external safety testing and says adversarial prompts informed fine-tuning. This challenges an interpretation of no outside scrutiny, but does not demonstrate independent authority to approve or block release.

evidence_items.locator: Section 4, opening paragraph; supporting detail in sections 4.3–4.4 and Introduction footnote 2
evidence_items.explanation: The release report documents systematic safety evaluations and iterative testing during development. It also records withholding the 34B model because there was insufficient time to complete red teaming, which further challenges the sweeping account of haste without prior results.

unresolved_gaps: The inspected records do not establish that an independent body had authority over Meta's release decision.
Model-level evaluations do not establish scientific consensus about the overall societal effects of releasing model weights.
The records do not establish the fastest technically possible development schedule.
